# `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/scratch_ops.py`

Source: [scratch_ops.py](../../../../scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/scratch_ops.py)

```text
Scratch operations on the site where a run is computed, for the run manager on another host (it calls this over
ssh, e.g. pawna -> pegasus). Prints one JSON object.

  scratch_ops.py stat  <run.conf>            size and mtime of every kept file (retention.py; not logs/events),
                                             content hash of the cosmology files
  scratch_ops.py usage <run.conf>            bytes in the run's sim and halo directories; free/total of SCRATCH
  scratch_ops.py trash <run.conf> <stamp>    move the sim and halo directories to SCRATCH/.trash/<run>_<stamp>/
  scratch_ops.py undo  <run.conf> <dir>      move them back
  scratch_ops.py purge <run.conf> <dir>      delete the trash directory <dir> (must be inside SCRATCH/.trash)
  scratch_ops.py delete_plan <run.conf> <json>   what `delete` removes, with sizes (json: SCRATCH, STEM, REAL, used
                                                 when run.conf itself is gone)
  scratch_ops.py delete <run.conf> <json>        delete the run from SCRATCH: its sim, halo and state directories, its
                                                 trash directories, and the set-up's shared directories when no other
                                                 realisation is left in them. Never the archive.
The manager checks the archive (on its own host) before it asks for trash or purge; the path guards are here.
```

## Contents

- [`guard`](#guard) - Resolve `path`; refuse (SystemExit with a JSON error) unless it is strictly inside `under` and contains the run name.
- [`du`](#du) - Total size in bytes of the files under `top` (`lstat`: links are not followed).
- [`delete_targets`](#delete_targets) - (run directories, shared set-up directories) that `delete` removes, all inside SCRATCH: the run's sim, halo and state directories and its trash directories; the set-up directories &lt;kind&gt;/&lt;stem&gt; (shared cosmology files, scales.txt) only when no other realisation r&lt;N&gt; is left in them.
- [`rmtree_w`](#rmtree_w) - shutil.rmtree, making read-only directories writable first (archive-style 0555 copies).
- [`delete_run`](#delete_run) - delete\_plan / delete: [[path, bytes], ...] of the run's directories and the shared ones.
- [`main`](#main) - Command line used by the manager (locally or over ssh): `scratch_ops.py <cmd> <run.conf> [json]` with cmd delete\_plan, delete, stat, usage, trash, undo or purge. Prints a JSON result (see the module docstring).

## guard

```python
guard(E, path, under)
```

Resolve `path`; refuse (SystemExit with a JSON error) unless it is strictly inside `under` and
contains the run name.

## du

```python
du(top)
```

Total size in bytes of the files under `top` (`lstat`: links are not followed).

## delete_targets

```python
delete_targets(E)
```

(run directories, shared set-up directories) that `delete` removes, all inside SCRATCH: the run's sim, halo and
state directories and its trash directories; the set-up directories &lt;kind&gt;/&lt;stem&gt; (shared cosmology files,
scales.txt) only when no other realisation r&lt;N&gt; is left in them.

## rmtree_w

```python
rmtree_w(path)
```

shutil.rmtree, making read-only directories writable first (archive-style 0555 copies).

## delete_run

```python
delete_run(E, plan_only)
```

delete\_plan / delete: [[path, bytes], ...] of the run's directories and the shared ones.

## main

```python
main()
```

Command line used by the manager (locally or over ssh): `scratch_ops.py <cmd> <run.conf> [json]`
with cmd delete\_plan, delete, stat, usage, trash, undo or purge. Prints a JSON result (see the module docstring).
